title: "M0-08: Corrections keep history"
format: html

**Feature ID:** `decide-corrections-keep-history`.

**Owner:** `pipsystem` design record. Release coordination belongs to `pipdata`;
`stamp` manages artifact versions.

**Git author:** R. Andres Castaneda. **Original recorder:** UNKNOWN.

## Decision

Preserve replaced artifact versions and dated release-version references so
analysts can identify both prior and corrected online states. Artifact versions
alone do not identify which version a release used on a given date. Keep the
existing correction window and frozen-release rules.

**Inputs:** A correction to a published release within its correction window,
and the artifact versions that the correction replaces. A fix after freezing
belongs to a new release.

**Outputs:** Retained replaced versions and dated references that identify what
the release served before and after correction.

## Check and gaps

**2026-11-25, pinned-record comparison: PASS.** Read the approvals and integrated
text with `git show`. The design requires both parts of the history and retains
the published correction window and the rule that fixes after freezing need a
new release.

**Runtime: NOT RUN.** Atomic capture, historical retrieval, freeze enforcement,
and release-aware retention remain Open. Loading a retained artifact version does
not prove that a complete historical release can be recovered.
